mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that triggers risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals supply chain disruption that reduces corporate profits and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) relative to its 6-month moving average signals strong aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals monetary tightening that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in employment (PAYEMS < 158000) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 3.8%) together signal severe labor market contraction that reduces consumer spending and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS < 158000 and UNRATE > 3.8%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer spending growth (RSAFS growth > 10%), the economy enters late-cycle expansion that triggers policy tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS growth > 10%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
